headline: Trevecca win every match since their only defeat
dek: Trevecca beat West Alabama at home and have won every match since Lee won at Trevecca in September, their only defeat in fifteen this season. AUM won at Union and stay level with them at the head of the table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals have not meant points: West Alabama have scored 43 and conceded 26, and have won six of their sixteen matches.

wire.line: Trevecca won at AUM and now share top spot; Hunter Walker has kept seven clean sheets behind them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches have passed their date with no result, and all three are Christian Brothers', the earliest at home to McKendree.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UAH have conceded eleven goals in fourteen matches and have lost only once, at AUM.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Spring Hill have scored three goals in twelve matches and have yet to win one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Charles Carriglitto has conceded ten goals for Lee and kept six clean sheets.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: David Nunez has scored sixteen goals for West Alabama.

last_match.line: AUM's only conference defeat came against Trevecca; Union have not beaten a conference side since September.

next_match.line: Montevallo have won every match since West Alabama beat them, and have scored in every one since October began.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
